name: listen-addr-from-env
prompt: main.go hard-codes the listen address. Make it configurable: add a helper listenAddr(getenv func(string) string) string in main.go that returns the value of the ADDR environment variable when it is a valid host:port or :port address, and falls back to ":8080" when the variable is unset or empty. An ADDR that is set but malformed (no colon, or non-numeric port) must cause main to exit before listening; implement the validation inside listenAddr by returning a second error return value instead: change the signature to listenAddr(getenv func(string) string) (string, error) and have main log the error and exit with status 2. Use the helper in main so tests can inject their own getenv.
